summary: Hess Midstream LP filed an 8-K disclosing a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated October 6, 2026 with Chevron subsidiaries Noble Energy, CMH NewCo and Hess Investments North Dakota. HESM acquires 100% of Chevron Midstream Holdings' DJ Basin gathering, processing and storage assets, the HINDL Interests (449,000 Class A shares plus 77,827,485 Class B units) and the HIP GP Interest, eliminating Chevron's consolidated ownership; Chevron's stake is cancelled, cutting outstanding shares nearly 40%. Consideration terms were not fully disclosed in the excerpt. What to watch: exchange ratio, closing conditions and HESM's post-deal governance and leverage.
